common.greeting: Hi there! I'm Pepper, your Oilgate Vacation Rentals concierge. Ask me anything about our three private 3-bedroom Akron homes — Oakdale Unit 1, Oakdale Unit 2 (with the Penthouse Suite!), and Parkgate — including amenities, beds, check-in times, parking, pets, nearby spots, or how to reserve!
common.units:
We offer three private 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom homes in Akron, Ohio — all with smart home entry, Cable TV + free pay-per-view, fast Wi-Fi, free parking, and no cleaning fees, ever:
• Oakdale Unit 1: First-floor charm with wood coffered ceilings, workspace in each bedroom, full private kitchen.
• Oakdale Unit 2: Upper-level home featuring the huge PENTHOUSE SUITE spanning the entire upper floor, separate dining room, and workspaces in each bedroom.
• Oilgate at Parkgate: Completely renovated home with 2 queen + 1 full beds, 75-inch TV, private deck, and big yard.
common.cleaning: No cleaning fees, ever — unless house rules are broken.
common.checkin: Your personal smart home door code is sent at 2:45 PM. Check-in starts at 3:00 PM and checkout is 11:00 AM (Akron local time).
common.pets: Pets are not allowed at any of our Akron homes — all three properties are pet-free.
common.nearby: All three homes are minutes from Akron's famous Swenson's, Highland Square, LeBron James' I PROMISE School, the LeBron James Home Court museum, and Blossom Music Center.
common.booking: To book: pick your stay in the Choose your stay selector, enter Check in, Check out, and Guests under Find your dates, and click Reserve to see your exact live total and finish checkout.
common.rules: Quiet hours are 10:00 PM to 10:00 AM (Akron local time). Up to 6 overnight guests and up to 3 visitors. No parties, smoking, or pets. Minimum booking age 18. Guests are responsible for damage they cause. Oilgate Realty is not liable for injury or loss of personal property, except as required by law.
common.contact: Email us anytime at oilgaterealty@gmail.com, or click Reserve above to review dates and checkout. We never share personal phone numbers.
